matches.description: Compute the dense monic coefficients of det(lambda I - A) for a square symbolic matrix whose entries are rational functions in declared algebraically independent variables.
matches.title: Compute an exact symbolic characteristic polynomial

matches.description: Deterministic exact rational enclosure of one sparse scalar QQ polynomial on a complete axis-aligned box. It contains the full image, need not be the exact range, and containing zero does not prove a root. Bounds: 4,096 terms; degree 32768 per variable and 262144 total; 32768-digit coefficient and 32768-digit input-endpoint components; 32,768 term-axis pairs; 65,536-digit intermediate components; 32,768-digit result components; 10,485,760-byte canonical retained-source result.
matches.title: Enclose a rational polynomial on a rational box

matches.description: Compute the exact eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicities of a square symbolic matrix using SymPy's eigenvals. Entries may be rational functions in declared algebraically independent variables; eigenvalues are returned as canonical SymPy expression strings.
matches.title: Compute exact symbolic eigenvalues

matches.description: Compute f(A) over QQ by bounded exact Horner evaluation. The result retains the source matrix and canonical one-variable rational polynomial and independently replays the defining evaluation.
matches.title: Evaluate an exact rational polynomial at a square matrix

matches.description: Compute the determinant of a square matrix whose entries are rational functions in declared algebraically independent variables, using SymPy's exact fraction-free Bareiss algorithm.
matches.title: Compute an exact symbolic matrix determinant (det) over QQ(t_1, ..., t_n)
